settings.content:
For any questions about our products or assistance with your order, feel free to reach out to us by email. We typically respond within 1–2 business days. To speed things up, kindly provide your order number or the email address you used during checkout.

Whether you need more information about a product or a status update on your order, our support team is ready to help and will get back to you as soon as they can. We appreciate your patience!

• Frequently Asked Questions
  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service

Contact information:
Store Name: Kerry Ann's
Address: 41 York Rd, London SE1 7NJ, United Kingdom
Email: support@kerryanns.com
Phone: +44 7418 316044
Contact: Contact Page

Customer Service: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM BST

We aim to respond to all emails within 1–2 business days.

Thank you for shopping with Kerry Ann's

custom_css: /* Outline the Name + Email + Message boxes */.form input[type="text"],.form input[type="email"],.form textarea {border: 1px solid #000000 !important; /* change color if needed */ border-radius: 3px !important; /* optional smoothing */}

/* On focus (when clicked) */.form input[type="text"]:focus,.form input[type="email"]:focus,.form textarea:focus {border-color: #333333 !important; /* darker outline on focus */ box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); /* subtle focus glow */}
